text.p: Stocks of peanuts held in U.S. commercial storage on July 31 totaled 758 million lbs of equivalent farmer stock, down from 1.20 billion lbs a year ago, the U.S. Agriculture Department said.
End-July stocks included 66.63 million lbs of farmer stock versus 48.57 million lbs a year ago.
Shelled peanuts totaled 659.9 million lbs of equivalent farmer stock versus 1.08 billion lbs a year ago. July roasting stocks totaled 31.0 million lbs versus 70.6 million a year ago.
There were no Commodity Credit Corporation uncommitted stocks in July versus none a year earlier, USDA said.
End-July stocks of shelled peanuts included 369.9 million lbs of edible grades and 126.3 million lbs of oil stock.
July millings totaled 66.6 million lbs, including 2.7 million lbs of Virginia peanuts, 63.9 million lbs of runners and no lbs of Spanish-type peanuts.
Shelled peanuts crushed for oil, cake and meal totaled 71.5 million lbs, the department said.
